notes: WhaleChat 3.80.0 — frontend and backend redeployed together on Appwrite. Email now goes through Appwrite Messaging (project SMTP provider) for verification codes and admin email, with Brevo SMTP/API fallback. State writes use a cross-instance lock and merge so a deposit or account change can no longer be overwritten by a parallel function instance. Chat keeps instant local echo, queues messages while a device is offline, and delivers them to the other device on reconnect.
